title: CMT本土供应链：价值凸显，能否支撑中国AI芯片需求？
speaker: MS Huahong

segments.en: Because we need to understand the meaning of the market, CMT is a DRAM company. And it's supporting the local supply chains initially.
segments.zh: 我们需要理解市场的意义，CMT是一家DRAM公司，最初它支持本土供应链。

segments.en: And the local supply chain, the China market itself, it has been open to everyone.
segments.zh: 本土供应链和中国市场本身一直对所有人开放。

segments.en: Because the CMT was not capable of delivering what they need, but it's catching up.
segments.zh: 因为CMT此前无法满足需求，但它正在追赶。

segments.en: And as David mentioned, that it's moving to HBM and more sophisticated devices as well.
segments.zh: 正如David提到的，它正向HBM和更复杂的器件迈进。

segments.en: So if CMT is capable of delivering what they need, then the meaning of the market is going to be a lot different than before. So that is the real value of this company's growth potential in terms of market care.
segments.zh: 如果CMT能够满足需求，那么市场的意义将大不相同。这就是该公司在市场份额方面增长潜力的真正价值。
